# map — enumerate a site's URLs

Field names are the JSON body names; MCP clients see the same names in the
tool's `inputSchema`, so this file is a fallback for raw-HTTP calls and for
reading a `16002` message that names a field.

### `flowda_map` · `POST /v1/map`

Scope `map` · `/v1` budget 130s · gateway pre-charge 1 credit.

| field | type | required | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| country | string | no | Access region, uppercase two-letter code. · default `US` |
| domain_filter | string | no | `domain` keeps same-host links only. · one of `domain`, `all` · default `all` |
| limit | integer | no | default `5000` · range 1–100000 |
| sitemap | string | no | How sitemaps are used. · one of `skip`, `include`, `only` · default `include` |
| url | string | yes | Site to enumerate; the host must be publicly resolvable. |

Body field names are identical for `application/json` and `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.
